Introduction

Introduction
============

‍

The Itihad Network is a blockchain-based platform designed to facilitate secure, transparent, and Sharia-compliant financial transactions and interactions. It integrates Bitcoin, alongside gold and silver tokens, within a decentralized framework governed by a DAO of Trustees.

The network leverages advanced technologies like Ethereum and zk-SNARKs to ensure privacy and security, supporting applications such as identity management, financial services, smart contracts, and civic engagement. Through innovative governance and cutting-edge technology, the Itihad Network aims to build a resilient, inclusive, and ethical ecosystem for the global Muslim community.

This whitepaper explores the vision, historical context, guiding concepts, and technical architecture of the Itihad Network, aiming to provide a comprehensive overview of its potential to enhance Islamic finance and governance.

‍

Paper Structure
---------------

This whitepaper is structured to provide a thorough understanding of the Itihad Network's objectives, methodologies, and applications. Each section builds upon the previous one to present a cohesive narrative of how the Network operates and the benefits it offers.

1.  [**Introduction**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/introduction)
    : Outlines the purpose, vision, historical context, problems, solutions, and guiding concepts of the Itihad Network.
2.  [**Applications**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/applications)
    : Details the various applications of the Network in areas such as identity, finance, contracts, civic engagement, social safety net, collective action, and credentialing.
3.  [**Points of Access**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/points-of-access)
    : Describes the different ways users can interact with the Network, including wallets, third-party apps, political action portals, services registries, and admin dashboards.
4.  [**Proof of Personhood**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/proof-of-personhood)
    : Explains the mechanisms for authentication, deduplication, recovery, revocation, expiry, and verification of identities within the Network.
5.  [**Technical Architecture**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/technical-architecture)
    : Provides an in-depth look at the technological framework and components that power the Itihad Network, including user agents, communications infrastructure, currencies, payment protocols, smart contracts, notarization, tokenized assets, and SDK.
6.  [**Network Governance**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/network-governance)
    : Discusses the governance structure of the Network, including the foundation, board of trustees, treasury, Zakat distribution, private courts, and charter cities.
7.  [**Concerns & Limitations**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/concerns-limitations)
    : Addresses potential challenges and limitations, such as illegal activity, tax evasion, and compliance with international sanctions.
8.  [**Essential Reading**](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/essential-reading)
    : Lists recommended resources to deepen understanding of the concepts and technologies discussed in the whitepaper.

‍

How to Read
-----------

To get the most out of this whitepaper, it is recommended to:

1.  Start with the [Essential Reading](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/essential-reading)
     section to familiarize yourself with key concepts and terminology.
2.  Refer to the **Paper Structure** section (above) for an overview of the document’s organization and content.
3.  Review the [Applications](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/applications)
     and [Technical Architecture](https://ubermart.co/itihad-whitepaper/technical-architecture)
     sections to understand the practical implementations and technical details of the Network.

Introduction

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Guiding Concepts

Guiding Concepts
================

‍

The Itihad Network Blockchain is built upon a foundation of Islamic principles and values. These guiding concepts ensure that the network aligns with the ethical, social, and legal frameworks of Islam, providing a trustworthy and equitable platform for the Muslim community. The following sections outline the core guiding concepts that underpin the Itihad Network.

‍

Aims of Islamic Law
-------------------

Islamic law, or Sharia, forms the basis of the Itihad Network's guiding principles. Derived from the Quran, Hadith, and other religious texts, Sharia provides a comprehensive legal framework for Muslims. The Network adheres to the Five Maqasid, or objectives, of Sharia: the protection of religion (Dīn), soul (Nafs), intellect ('Aql), lineage (Nasl), and property or wealth (Māl).

Preservation of Wealth is a critical aspect, ensuring financial practices that protect and grow wealth in a manner consistent with Islamic law. The Itihad Network addresses currency in Islam by avoiding Riba (usury), Gharar (excessive uncertainty), and Maisir (gambling). Recognizing the fatwa that supports the use of Bitcoin as a compliant digital currency within Islamic finance, the network aims to provide alternatives to traditional fiat currencies and large technology companies, promoting decentralized and Sharia-compliant financial solutions.

‍

A High-Trust Society
--------------------

The Itihad Network aims to foster Amana, the fundamental value of trust, which is central to an Islamic society. In an environment where Amana is prioritized, transactions and interactions are conducted with confidence and integrity. By promoting transparency and accountability, the network strives to build a high-trust society. The decentralized nature of the blockchain ensures that all transactions are transparent and verifiable, further enhancing Amana within the community.

‍

Judicial Independence
---------------------

Judicial independence is a key aspect of Islamic governance, allowing different communities to maintain their legal and social systems. The Itihad Network supports this principle by advocating for a system where Muslims can have their courts and social safety nets while respecting the rights of others to do the same.

Islam allows non-Muslims to have their courts and social safety nets, and the Itihad Network expects to be given the same rights by governments, ensuring that Muslims can govern their affairs in accordance with Islamic principles. By recognizing and respecting the legal and social systems of other communities, the network promotes a harmonious coexistence and mutual respect among different groups.

Identity

Identity
========

‍

In the Itihad Network, secure and verified identity management is essential for maintaining trust and preventing fraud. By leveraging community-based verification and advanced authentication methods, the Network ensures that every member is uniquely identified and trusted.

‍

Community-Based Verification
----------------------------

The Itihad Network relies on trusted community members and local Islamic organizations to verify user identities. This decentralized approach ensures that each user is verified by individuals who are familiar with their background and character, fostering a strong sense of trust and community.

‍

Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
---------------------------------

To enhance security, the Network employs Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This includes a combination of:

*   **Something the User Knows**: Passwords or PINs.
*   **Something the User Has**: Mobile devices for verification codes.
*   **Something the User Is**: Verification through social connections and endorsements from trusted community members.

‍

Family & Social Recovery
------------------------

The Itihad Network also allows for the verification of family units. This ensures that all members of a family are linked and verified through the network, providing additional layers of trust and security. Family-based verification helps in managing family-related matters such as inheritance and guardianship, ensuring compliance with Islamic principles.

Additionally, in case of lost credentials, social recovery mechanisms enable trusted family members or community leaders to assist in the recovery process, maintaining security and trust within the network.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Secure Access to Services**: Users can securely log into the Itihad Network to access various services, such as financial transactions, community forums, and educational resources. This secure access prevents unauthorized usage and ensures that only verified members can utilize these services.
*   **Proving Identity**: In situations where users need to prove their identity, such as accessing community resources or participating in governance, the Itihad Network provides a reliable verification mechanism. This ensures that individuals are who they claim to be, maintaining the integrity of community interactions.
*   **Preventing Fraud**: By implementing stringent identity verification processes, the Itihad Network effectively prevents fraudulent activities. Each user is thoroughly vetted through community verification and MFA, ensuring that only legitimate members can participate.
*   **Building Trust**: Secure identity management fosters a high-trust environment within the Network. Community members can interact confidently, knowing that everyone has been verified according to strict standards aligned with Islamic principles.

Finance

Finance
=======

‍

In the Itihad Network, financial applications are designed to adhere to Islamic principles while leveraging the benefits of blockchain technology. This ensures that all financial activities are transparent, secure, and Sharia-compliant.

‍

Decentralized Finance
---------------------

The Itihad Network facilitates peer-to-peer financial transactions that are both instant and borderless. This decentralized approach eliminates the need for intermediaries, reducing transaction costs and increasing efficiency.

‍

Peer-to-Peer Lending
--------------------

Users can lend and borrow money directly from each other without the need for traditional banks, ensuring compliance with Islamic laws prohibiting interest (Riba). This system enables users to access necessary funds while adhering to Sharia principles, fostering financial inclusivity.

‍

Investment Opportunities
------------------------

The Network provides Sharia-compliant investment options, allowing users to invest in projects that adhere to Islamic ethical standards. This ensures that all investments are made in a manner consistent with Islamic values, promoting ethical and responsible financial growth.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Instant Cross-Border Transactions**: The Itihad Network enables instant cross-border financial transactions, allowing users to send and receive money globally without the delays and costs associated with traditional banking systems. This is particularly beneficial for supporting family members abroad or conducting international business.
*   **Small Business Support**: The Network supports microfinance initiatives, providing small loans to entrepreneurs and small businesses in a Sharia-compliant manner. This fosters economic growth and helps alleviate poverty within the community.

Contracts

Contracts
=========

‍

The Itihad Network leverages blockchain technology to facilitate transparent, secure, and Sharia-compliant contracts. By using smart contracts, the Network ensures that all agreements are automated and enforced according to Islamic legal principles.

‍

Smart Contracts
---------------

Smart contracts are self-executing contracts with the terms of the agreement directly written into code. These contracts automate processes, reduce the need for intermediaries, and ensure compliance with Sharia law.

‍

Types of Agreements
-------------------

The Itihad Network can manage a variety of agreements, automating and ensuring compliance with Islamic law:

*   **Business Agreements**: Automates and enforces business transactions such as buying and selling goods, and providing services.
*   **Lease and Rental Agreements**: Manages lease and rental agreements, automating payments and ensuring compliance with Islamic law.
*   **Employment Contracts**: Manages employment agreements, including automating salary payments, tracking work hours, and managing other employment-related activities.
*   **Marriage Contracts**: Manages marriage agreements, including dowry payments, financial arrangements, and other contractual obligations.
*   **Insurance Contracts**: Handles insurance agreements, automating claims processing and ensuring Sharia-compliant terms.

‍

Smart Contract Templates
------------------------

To streamline the creation of various agreements, the Network offers smart contract templates for common use cases such as business transactions, leases, employment, marriage, and insurance. These templates are pre-validated for Sharia compliance, making it easy for users to deploy contracts quickly and securely.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Automated Business Transactions:** Businesses within the Itihad Network can use smart contracts to automate transactions, ensuring that payments are made promptly and that all terms are met. This reduces the risk of disputes and enhances trust between parties.
*   **Transparent Property Leasing:** Property owners can lease their properties using smart contracts, ensuring that rental payments are made automatically and that both parties adhere to the lease terms. This transparency reduces conflicts and ensures a smooth leasing process.
*   **Efficient Employment Management:** Employers can manage employment contracts using smart contracts, automating salary payments and tracking work hours. This ensures that employees are paid accurately and on time, and that all employment terms are met.
*   **Secure Marriage Agreements:** Couples can enter into marriage contracts with predefined terms, ensuring that all financial and legal obligations are clearly defined and adhered to. This provides a secure foundation for marital relationships.
*   **Fair Insurance Processes:** Insurance providers can manage policies and claims through smart contracts, ensuring that all terms are met fairly and transparently. This builds trust in the insurance system and ensures that claims are processed efficiently.

Collective Action

Collective Action
=================

‍

The Itihad Network empowers the community to take collective action, enabling members to collaborate on common goals and address shared concerns. By leveraging blockchain technology, the Network ensures transparency, accountability, and efficiency in organizing collective efforts.

‍

Organizing Community Projects
-----------------------------

The Network supports the organization and funding of community projects. This includes initiatives such as building infrastructure, supporting educational programs, and improving local services. Community members can propose projects by detailing objectives, required resources, and expected outcomes. These projects can be funded through community contributions, ensuring transparency in the collection and use of funds. The Network also provides real-time updates on project progress, ensuring accountability and community involvement.

‍

Class Actions
-------------

The Itihad Network enables community members to initiate and fund class actions to address common grievances. This collective legal approach allows individuals to pool resources and efforts to seek justice and address issues affecting the community. Community members can propose class actions by detailing the issue, legal approach, and required support. Funds and resources are transparently allocated to support the class action, ensuring effective use of contributions. The Network connects members with legal experts and organizations that can provide guidance and representation.

‍

Collective Bargaining
---------------------

The Network supports collective bargaining efforts, enabling groups within the community to negotiate better terms and conditions in various contexts, such as employment, business agreements, and service provision. The Network provides tools and platforms to facilitate negotiations between community groups and external entities, combines resources to strengthen bargaining power, and ensures that all negotiations and agreements are transparent and comply with Islamic principles.

An example of this is group buying initiatives through Islamic guilds (Asnaf), where members can pool resources for bulk purchases. By combining their purchasing power, Islamic guilds can obtain goods at discounted rates and negotiate better terms, allowing them to compete more effectively with large corporations.

‍

**Real-Life Use Cases**
-----------------------

*   **Community Infrastructure Projects**: Community members can propose and fund infrastructure projects such as building mosques, schools, or community centers. This collective effort ensures that resources are pooled effectively and projects are completed transparently.
*   **Legal Class Actions**: Members can initiate class actions to address issues such as discrimination, unfair practices, or other legal grievances affecting the community. By pooling resources, the community can effectively seek justice and support those impacted.
*   **Employment and Business Negotiations**: Groups of workers or business owners can use the Network to negotiate better terms and conditions with employers or service providers. This collective bargaining strengthens their position and ensures fair treatment.
*   **Group Buying and Land Acquisition**: Islamic guilds (Asnaf) can organize group buying initiatives to purchase goods in bulk or acquire land collectively. This allows members to benefit from lower prices and shared ownership, fostering economic empowerment within the community.

Organizations

Organizations
=============

‍

The Itihad Network supports the creation and management of various organizational structures allowed under Sharia, ensuring they operate transparently and in compliance with Islamic principles. This includes Awqaf (endowments), Musharaka (partnerships), Asnaf (Islamic guilds), and other community-focused entities.

‍

Partnerships
------------

The Network facilitates the creation of Musharaka partnerships, allowing community members to pool resources for business ventures. These partnerships ensure shared ownership and profit distribution in accordance with Islamic law. Musharaka partnerships support entrepreneurial activities, fostering economic growth and innovation within the community by pooling expertise and resources.

‍

Trusts
------

Waqf is a charitable trust established by donating assets for public or community benefit. The assets are managed to generate income, which is then used for charitable purposes such as building schools, hospitals, and other community services. Awqaf (plural of Waqf) can be established and managed through the Network to support long-term community development projects. This includes funding for educational institutions, healthcare facilities, and other essential infrastructure, ensuring sustainable growth and benefit for the community.

‍

Guilds
------

Asnaf, or Islamic guilds, are a combination of a Waqf umbrella and a network of associated Musharakas. Under the Waqf umbrella, Asnaf can pool resources, brand collectively, distribute products efficiently, invest in research and development, and engage in collective bargaining. The Waqf provides a stable and sustainable funding base, allowing the Asnaf to focus on their specialized trades or crafts.

Each Sanf (singular of Asnaf) operates through a network of associated Musharaka partnerships. These partnerships allow members to collaborate on projects, share profits and losses, and support each other’s growth. By leveraging the combined strengths of the Waqf and Musharaka structures, Asnaf can compete more effectively with large corporations. They can negotiate better prices for raw materials, invest in joint ventures, and ensure fair trade practices, fostering economic empowerment and professional development within the community.

‍

Financial Structures in Organizations
-------------------------------------

The Network also facilitates various Sharia-compliant financial structures to support organizational activities.

*   **Profit-Sharing (Mudaraba)**: This structure involves one party providing capital and the other providing expertise and management. Profits are shared according to a pre-agreed ratio, while losses are borne by the capital provider. This supports investment projects and entrepreneurial ventures.
*   **Cost-Plus Financing (Murabaha)**: An item is purchased by the financier and sold to the customer at an agreed-upon profit margin, with the customer paying over time. This structure is used for trade financing and asset purchases.
*   **Leasing (Ijara)**: The financier buys and leases out an asset to the customer for a fixed rental fee. Ownership remains with the financier, but the customer benefits from its use. Commonly used for equipment and property leasing, this structure supports business operations and growth.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Establishing Educational Institutions**: Through Awqaf, community members can fund and establish schools and universities, providing access to quality education and fostering intellectual growth.
*   **Business Ventures**: Musharaka and Mudaraba partnerships enable entrepreneurs to launch and manage businesses collectively, sharing risks and profits. This collaborative approach supports innovation and economic development.
*   **Trade and Craft Guilds**: Asnaf can organize group buying of raw materials, negotiate better terms with suppliers, and support the professional development of their members. This helps ensure fair trade practices and economic stability for specific trades.
*   **Charitable Trusts**: Waqf can fund long-term projects such as building schools, hospitals, and community centers, providing lasting benefits and fostering sustainable development within the community.
*   **Asset Financing and Leasing**: Murabaha and Ijarah structures can facilitate the purchase and use of assets such as machinery, vehicles, and property, supporting business operations and growth.

Points of Access

Points of Access
================

‍

The Points of Access chapter outlines the key entry points into the Itihad Network, designed to facilitate secure, efficient, and Sharia-compliant interactions for users. This chapter begins with the Wallet, a comprehensive platform for managing digital assets, enabling secure transactions, session management, and more.

Next, the integration of Third Party Apps ensures that external applications comply with Islamic principles while enhancing functionality. The Public Action Portal empowers community members to engage in civic activities, including voter registration and campaign financing. The Registry Service securely manages asset and land registrations, Zakat payments, and financial aid applications. Finally, the Admin Dashboard provides tools for the DAO of Trustees to monitor Network health, vote on proposals, verify identities, and manage critical accounts.

Proof of Personhood

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Deduplication

Deduplication
=============

‍

For Proof of Personhood (PoP) to be effective, it must ensure the uniqueness of each credential. If PoP can be acquired multiple times or transferred to fraudulent actors, it fails its purpose. Thus, deduplication is a critical and challenging aspect of any PoP mechanism.

‍

Implementation
--------------

Ensuring that each user receives exactly one PoP credential is the most challenging aspect of an inclusive and secure PoP system. In the Itihad Network, deduplication is achieved through a combination of community verification, social graph analysis, and advanced algorithms.

1.  **Community Verification**: Trusted community members or local Islamic organizations verify each individual’s identity. This decentralized approach helps ensure that each person can only register once.
2.  **Social Graph Analysis**: The Network analyzes the social connections of users to detect and prevent duplicate registrations. By examining relationships and interactions within the community, the system can identify and eliminate fraudulent accounts.
3.  **Advanced Algorithms**: The Network employs sophisticated algorithms to cross-reference personal information and detect duplicates. This includes analyzing data such as email addresses, phone numbers, and other identifiers to ensure each user is unique.
4.  **Regular Audits**: The Network conducts regular audits to identify and remove duplicate entries. This ongoing process helps maintain the integrity of the PoP system.

Concerns & Limitations

Concerns & Limitations
======================

‍

The Itihad Network, while offering numerous benefits, must address several critical concerns and limitations to maintain its integrity and compliance. This chapter delves into three primary issues: illegal activity, tax evasion, and sanctions. By understanding and mitigating these risks, the Network aims to create a secure and trustworthy environment for its users. Robust measures such as stringent KYC/AML procedures, continuous monitoring, and collaboration with authorities are implemented to prevent misuse.

Additionally, automated reporting and user education promote tax compliance, while strategies for navigating international sanctions ensure adherence to regulations.

‍

Disclaimer
----------

Despite these measures, it is crucial to recognize that no system is entirely immune to misuse. The Itihad Network remains committed to continuously improving its security protocols to mitigate these risks and uphold the integrity of the platform. Users are advised to remain vigilant and proactive in following best practices to ensure their activities comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

Illegal Activity

Illegal Activity
================

‍

One of the significant concerns surrounding the Itihad Network is the potential for illegal activities. While the Network aims to promote transparency and accountability, there are inherent risks associated with any decentralized system.

‍

Mitigation Measures
-------------------

1.  **Strict KYC/AML Procedures**: The Itihad Network employs decentralized Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) procedures to ensure that all participants are verified and transactions are monitored. This helps in identifying and preventing illicit activities.
2.  **Monitoring and Auditing**: Continuous monitoring and periodic auditing of transactions are conducted to detect any suspicious activities. Advanced algorithms and AI are utilized to flag unusual patterns that may indicate illegal behavior.
3.  **Collaboration with Authorities**: The Network collaborates with global regulatory bodies and law enforcement agencies to ensure compliance with international laws. Any detected illegal activities are promptly reported to the relevant authorities.
4.  **Community Governance**: The decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) structure includes community governance mechanisms that allow members to vote on and implement measures to enhance security and prevent misuse.
5.  **Education and Awareness**: The Network actively educates its members on the importance of adhering to legal standards and the potential consequences of engaging in illegal activities.

Zakat Distribution

Zakat Distribution
==================

‍

The Zakat Distribution system within the Itihad Network is designed to ensure efficient, transparent, and Sharia-compliant collection and distribution of Zakat funds. Integrating with the Registry Service portal, this system provides both automated and manual options to cater to the needs and preferences of community members.

‍

Collecting Zakat
----------------

The Network facilitates automated Zakat collection according to Sharia principles. This ensures that every eligible member’s Zakat obligations are calculated and collected accurately, promoting compliance and ease of use. By integrating with the Registry Service portal, the Network can accurately assess and collect Zakat based on each member's financial status.

‍

Default Distribution
--------------------

By default, the collected Zakat is distributed as Universal Basic Income (UBI) to all eligible applicants within the Network. This approach ensures that Zakat reaches those in need, providing a financial safety net and supporting the community's well-being.

‍

Manual Distribution
-------------------

For those who prefer to have more control over their Zakat contributions, the Network offers a manual distribution option. Members can choose to allocate their Zakat funds to a pre-approved and audited set of Awqaf (charitable endowments). This ensures that the funds are used effectively and in accordance with Islamic principles while allowing contributors to support causes they care about.

Proof of Personhood

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Proof of Personhood

Proof of Personhood
===================

Real identity is essential to building a robust Islamic society and economy. Pseudonymity is not viable within this system.

Different applications within the Itihad Network have varied requirements for Proof of Personhood (PoP). For critical uses such as governance and community engagement, a secure and inclusive PoP mechanism is necessary to prevent multiple registrations. The Itihad Network is establishing a high-assurance PoP system. The following sections detail the core components of PoP and their implementation within the Network.

‍

Building Blocks
---------------

An effective PoP mechanism comprises several essential components, including "deduplication" to ensure unique registrations, "authentication" to verify legitimate users, and "recovery" for lost credentials. This section provides an overview of these components.

A PoP system involves three primary actors and the data they exchange:

1.  **User**: An individual seeking to verify their identity to access resources or qualify for specific actions. In a PoP protocol, this involves proving uniqueness and personhood.
2.  **Credential**: A data set that serves as proof of the user’s attributes, confirming they are a unique human. This can include government IDs or secure verification methods.
3.  **Issuer**: A trusted entity that verifies the user’s information and issues a PoP credential, enabling the user to assert their identity.
4.  **Verifier**: An entity that checks the PoP credential’s authenticity to grant the user access to specific actions.

Use Cases

Use Cases
=========

‍

The Itihad Network is designed to serve a wide range of applications, addressing the unique needs of the Muslim community in various aspects of life. By leveraging blockchain technology, the network provides solutions that align with Islamic principles, ensuring secure, transparent, and efficient management of personal, commercial, and political affairs. Below are some of the primary use cases for the Itihad Network.

‍

Personal
--------

The Itihad Network offers robust solutions for individuals, ensuring that personal financial and legal matters are managed in a manner consistent with Islamic principles.

*   **Identity Management**: The Network offers secure and verifiable identity management solutions, helping individuals protect their personal information and ensuring their identities are not misused or stolen.
*   **Protecting and Storing Wealth**: The Network provides a secure platform for individuals to protect and store their wealth. Utilizing blockchain technology, it safeguards assets against theft, fraud, and economic instability, offering inflation-resistant storage options to preserve wealth over time.
*   **Inheritance Management**: The Network facilitates the distribution of inheritance according to Islamic law, automating the process to ensure wealth is divided correctly and transparently among heirs, preventing disputes and ensuring Sharia compliance.
*   **Resolving Family Disputes**: The Network provides mechanisms to resolve family disputes in a manner consistent with Islamic values. Using smart contracts and decentralized arbitration, it ensures disputes are settled fairly and transparently, fostering harmony within families.
*   **Social Safety Net**: The Network supports charitable giving by providing transparent and efficient mechanisms for Zakat and Sadaqa, ensuring donations are distributed properly and reach those in need, in accordance with Islamic principles.

‍

Commercial
----------

The Itihad Network supports Islamic commerce by providing solutions that adhere to Sharia principles, ensuring that all business activities are conducted ethically and transparently.

*   **Solving the Hand-to-Hand Problem**: The Network prevents double-selling of assets by ensuring transactions are unique and verifiable, maintaining transaction integrity.
*   **Ensuring Transaction Transparency**: The Network provides verifiable and transparent transactions, allowing all parties to see and confirm transaction details, thereby building trust and accountability.
*   **Facilitating Trade and Business**: The Network supports SMEs by streamlining cross-border trade, making it easier for businesses to operate internationally while adhering to Islamic principles.
*   **Smart Contracts for Islamic Finance**: The Network uses smart contracts to ensure compliance with Islamic finance principles, automating processes like profit-sharing and Sukuk issuance, reducing the need for intermediaries.
*   **Supply Chain Management**: The Network enhances supply chain transparency and efficiency, ensuring halal compliance throughout the supply chain and guaranteeing that products meet Islamic standards from production to consumption.

‍

Political
---------

The Itihad Network provides robust solutions for political engagement, enhancing democratic participation and ensuring transparency in political processes.

*   **Mobilizing Voters**: The Network offers tools to mobilize Muslims to vote in local elections. By providing secure and reliable platforms for voter registration and information dissemination, the Network helps ensure that the community is well-informed and motivated to participate in the electoral process.
*   **Campaign Financing**: The Network supports transparent and ethical campaign financing. By utilizing blockchain, the Network ensures that all campaign contributions are traceable and verifiable, reducing the risk of corruption and undue influence.
*   **Civic Engagement**: The Network provides platforms for civic engagement, enabling members of the Muslim community to participate actively in political discussions and decision-making processes. By fostering open and transparent communication, the Network helps build a more engaged and informed citizenry.

Introduction

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Historical Context

Historical Context
==================

‍

The historical challenges faced by the Muslim community highlight the need for innovative solutions that align with Islamic principles. Traditional governance systems have often struggled with issues of trust and efficiency. The Itihad Network addresses these challenges by offering a decentralized approach that emphasizes transparency, security, and community participation. By integrating advanced blockchain technology, the network provides a robust framework for managing identity, payments, and contracts in a way that is consistent with Islamic values and practices.

‍

The Impossible State
--------------------

Traditional governance structures in many Muslim communities have often been plagued by issues of corruption, inefficiency, and lack of transparency. These centralized systems fail to meet the needs of their citizens, leading to widespread mistrust and disenfranchisement.

Wael Hallaq, in his book "[The Impossible State,](https://cup.columbia.edu/book/the-impossible-state/9780231162579)
" critiques the modern state's failure to provide genuine Islamic governance, highlighting the need for innovative solutions that align more closely with Islamic principles. These systemic issues underscore the necessity for a new approach that the Itihad Network aims to fulfill.

‍

The Network State
-----------------

Building on the need for an alternative to traditional state structures, the Itihad Network proposes the concept of a "Network State" as a solution. This decentralized approach leverages blockchain technology to create a system of governance that is transparent, secure, and participatory. By distributing power and decision-making across a network of users, the Itihad Network ensures that no single entity can exert undue influence or control. This model aligns with Islamic principles of justice and community and provides a practical framework for modern governance.

As Balaji Srinivasan's "[The Network State](https://thenetworkstate.com/)
" suggests, such a system can fit within the mold of local governance, complementing rather than overthrowing existing state structures.

‍

Blockchain Revolution
---------------------

The adoption of a Network State model opens the door to leveraging the blockchain revolution, which presents a unique opportunity to revolutionize governance and financial systems within the Muslim community. Blockchain's inherent transparency, security, and decentralization address many of the issues that have historically plagued traditional systems.

By integrating blockchain technology, the Itihad Network can create a high-trust environment where transactions are secure and verifiable, and where individuals have greater control over their personal data and assets. This technological advancement supports the decentralized governance model proposed in "The Network State," addressing the inefficiencies and mistrust found in traditional governance structures.

‍

The Bitcoin Standard
--------------------

Moreover, the increasing acceptance and integration of digital currencies globally mark an opportune moment for the Itihad Network to introduce its Bitcoin Standard. Bitcoin's widespread recognition and established trust make it an ideal currency for facilitating seamless and secure transactions within the Itihad Network. This timing is strategic as it coincides with the broader blockchain revolution and the implementation of the network state model.

Saifedean Ammous, in his book "The Bitcoin Standard," discusses the advantages of Bitcoin as a decentralized, deflationary currency, reinforcing its suitability for the Itihad Network. By leveraging Bitcoin, the network can offer a reliable and efficient payment system that aligns with the needs and values of the Muslim community, such as usury-free transactions, transparency, and financial inclusion.

Civic Engagement

Civic Engagement
================

‍

The Itihad Network aims to enhance civic participation and empower the community through secure and transparent mechanisms. By leveraging blockchain technology, the Network ensures that civic activities such as voting organization, campaign funding, and collective actions are conducted with integrity and inclusiveness.

‍

Voting Organization
-------------------

The Itihad Network helps organize Muslims to vote in local elections, ensuring their voices are heard in the broader political landscape. The platform mobilizes community members to participate in local elections, ensuring high voter turnout and representation. It provides detailed information on local elections, candidates, and issues to help community members make informed decisions. Additionally, it coordinates transportation and other logistical support to help community members get to polling stations.

‍

Campaign Funding
----------------

The Network facilitates transparent and Sharia-compliant campaign funding, ensuring that political campaigns are funded ethically and transparently. All donations are recorded on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and preventing fraud. Campaign funds are managed in accordance with Islamic financial principles, ensuring ethical use of resources.

‍

Collective Action
-----------------

The Itihad Network supports collective action initiatives, enabling the community to organize and fund class actions or other collective efforts. Community members can collectively initiate and fund class actions to address common grievances or pursue shared goals. The Network provides tools for transparent and efficient allocation of resources for collective actions.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Community Voting Organization**: The Network mobilizes Muslims to participate in local elections, providing information on candidates and issues, coordinating transportation to polling stations, and ensuring the community's voices are represented in the political process.
*   **Ethical Campaign Funding**: Political campaigns within the community can be funded transparently and ethically, ensuring that all donations are accounted for and used in compliance with Islamic principles. This builds trust in the political process and encourages greater participation.
*   **Organizing Collective Efforts**: The Network enables the community to organize and fund collective efforts, such as class actions or community projects. This empowers members to take collective action on issues that matter to them, fostering a sense of unity and purpose.

Problems & Solutions

Problems & Solutions
====================

‍

The Itihad Network Blockchain aims to address several key issues that have historically impacted the Muslim community, particularly in areas where traditional systems have failed to align with Islamic principles. By leveraging blockchain technology, the Itihad Network provides innovative solutions to these problems, creating a secure, transparent, and ethical environment for transactions and interactions. Below are some of the primary issues and the corresponding solutions offered by the network.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a3bb701a587c1cbc64fb4_i29h90323f.avif)

**Figure 1** This four main solutions that blockchain offer.

‍

Usury
-----

Usury, or Riba, is explicitly prohibited in Islamic finance. Traditional financial systems, however, are deeply entrenched in interest-based transactions, creating a significant barrier for Muslims seeking to comply with their religious principles. The global financial system operates largely on Keynesian economics, which involves the extensive use of monetary policy tools such as the printing of money to manage economic cycles. This approach leads to inflation and devaluation of currency, which can be seen as a form of Riba since it erodes the real value of money over time.

The Itihad Network offers a solution by providing an interest-free financial environment. Utilizing blockchain technology, the network facilitates peer-to-peer lending and borrowing without interest, adhering to Islamic financial principles. The network also supports transactions using Bitcoin, and gold and silver-backed tokens, which are stable and Sharia-compliant alternatives to traditional fiat currencies. By leveraging these decentralized and deflationary digital assets, the network protects against the inflationary pressures and endless money printing inherent in Keynesian economics. This approach ensures that all financial transactions within the network are free from Riba and helps preserve the real value of money, aligning with Islamic principles and promoting economic justice.

‍

Surveillance & Data Privacy
---------------------------

In many parts of the world, Muslims face heightened scrutiny and surveillance, which can lead to a range of negative consequences. Despite evidence that the majority of terrorist attacks are not committed by Muslims, they are often disproportionately targeted. For example, between 2011 and 2016, 85% of global terrorist incidents occurred in largely Islamic states, but many of these attacks were intra-Muslim violence, not reflective of global Muslim terrorism​​ ([CSIS](https://www.csis.org/analysis/islam-and-patterns-terrorism-and-violent-extremism)
)​.

Furthermore, a notable example of privacy violations is the case of a popular Muslim prayer app that sold user data to government agencies, raising significant concerns about data misuse​​ ([Homeland Security Today](https://www.hstoday.us/subject-matter-areas/counterterrorism/what-the-stats-say-about-the-muslim-extremist-threat-in-america/)
)​.

The Itihad Network addresses these issues by leveraging the privacy-preserving features of blockchain technology. By decentralizing data storage and utilizing advanced encryption techniques, the network ensures that user data is secure and private. This approach reduces the risk of unauthorized surveillance and data breaches. Users retain full control over their data, managing permissions and access to ensure their privacy is maintained. This decentralized and secure framework allows individuals to interact and transact with confidence, knowing their personal information is protected.

‍

Censorship
----------

Censorship of Muslim voices, particularly during critical events, has been a significant issue. For instance, during the Gaza Genocide of 2024, many Muslim voices were censored on major social media platforms. Human Rights Watch documented over 1,050 cases of online censorship related to Palestine content on Meta platforms, primarily Instagram and Facebook. This suppression of protected speech during such a critical period highlights the need for a decentralized and unbiased communication platform​ ([Human Rights Watch](https://www.hrw.org/report/2023/12/21/metas-broken-promises/systemic-censorship-palestine-content-instagram-and)
)​.

Additionally, the American Muslim Bar Association (AMBA) reported that the propagation of misinformation about the Gaza conflict was matched by heavy censorship and intimidation of Muslim activists and voices in the United States​ ([AMBA](https://www.ambalegal.org/ambainthenews/amba-stands-against-the-genocide-of-palestinians-ampnbspthe-intimidation-censorship-and-retaliation-against-americans-exercising-free-speech)
)​.

The Itihad Network combats censorship by providing a decentralized platform for communication. By ensuring that no single entity can control or manipulate the flow of information, the network supports free expression and protects against the suppression of Muslim voices. This decentralized approach promotes a more equitable and inclusive digital environment.

‍

Misalignment
------------

A significant challenge within the Muslim community is the lack of coordination in political and economic actions. For example, the concept of the "Muslim Vote" has often been mis-coordinated, leading to fragmented political influence and underrepresentation in crucial decisions. This misalignment hinders the community’s ability to act collectively towards common goals.

The Itihad Network addresses this issue by providing a unified platform that encourages coordinated actions. By using blockchain technology to facilitate transparent and collaborative decision-making processes, the network helps align the efforts of the Muslim community in political, economic, and social spheres. This ensures that collective actions are more effective and impactful, enhancing the community's overall influence and representation.

‍

Social Safety Net

Social Safety Net
=================

‍

The Itihad Network provides a robust social safety net to support community members, ensuring that resources are distributed equitably and transparently in alignment with Islamic principles. By leveraging blockchain technology, the Network enhances the efficiency and accountability of social welfare programs.

‍

Zakat and Sadaqa
----------------

The Network facilitates the collection and distribution of Zakat and Sadaqa, ensuring that these charitable contributions reach those in need effectively. The system can automatically calculate the obligatory Zakat based on a user's financial status and facilitate its distribution to eligible recipients. Additionally, users can make voluntary Sadaqa donations to various causes, with full transparency on how funds are used and distributed.

‍

Welfare Programs
----------------

The Network supports various welfare programs aimed at providing assistance to the less fortunate members of the community. This includes direct financial aid, ensuring that funds are used responsibly and transparently. The Network also provides funding for medical expenses and health-related services to ensure that all community members have access to necessary healthcare. Educational assistance is also available, offering scholarships and funding for educational programs to enable access to quality education for all community members.

‍

Crisis Relief
-------------

In times of crisis, such as natural disasters or conflicts, the Network can facilitate rapid distribution of aid. Digital money can be transferred instantly to those in need, ensuring timely assistance and reducing the risk of corruption and fraud.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Efficient Charitable Giving**: The Itihad Network ensures that Zakat and Sadaqa donations are collected and distributed efficiently, providing full transparency and accountability. This helps build trust in the system and encourages more community members to contribute.
*   **Direct Financial Assistance**: Through the Network, community members in need can receive direct financial aid quickly and securely. This includes support for basic needs such as food, housing, and emergency expenses.
*   **Healthcare Funding**: The Network provides a platform for community members to fund healthcare expenses for those who cannot afford it. This includes direct payments to healthcare providers and support for purchasing medications.
*   **Educational Support**: The Network facilitates scholarships and educational funding, helping students pursue their studies without financial barriers. This ensures equal access to education and fosters the development of the community.
*   **Rapid Crisis Relief**: During times of crisis, the Network ensures swift distribution of aid through digital money transfers. This method guarantees timely assistance and minimizes the risk of corruption and fraud, ensuring that help reaches those who need it most.

Points of Access

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Wallet

Wallet
======

‍

The Wallet is a core feature of the Itihad Network, designed to provide secure, efficient, and Sharia-compliant management of digital assets. It facilitates various financial transactions and interactions within the Network, ensuring ease of use and robust security. The Wallet serves as the primary interface for users to engage with the Itihad Network's financial services transparently and in compliance with Islamic principles.

‍

Monitor Assets
--------------

The dashboard provides a clear overview of financial activities, including account balances and transaction history. Designed to be user-friendly, it makes it easy to track and manage funds while providing alerts and notifications for important activities.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a3f342337ef588860a306_it198324.avif)

**Figure 2** The dashboard of the Itihad app shows a view of the user’s assets.

‍

Make Payments
-------------

The Wallet supports secure peer-to-peer payments, enabling quick and straightforward transfers of funds between community members and merchants. Users can send and receive money instantly, making it convenient for everyday transactions. The Wallet also supports recurring payments, allowing users to set up automatic transfers for regular expenses. All transactions are compliant with Islamic principles, ensuring transparency and trust.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a3f54292840b5a795f276_it129451r2tf.avif)

**Figure 3** The Transfers screen allows users to send and request money, and to pay merchants.

‍

Assign Guardians
----------------

The Wallet includes a "Guardians" feature, enhancing security by allowing users to designate trusted individuals who can assist in recovering access to the Wallet if lost or compromised. Users can choose their Guardians from their contacts, ensuring that only trusted individuals have the ability to help recover their account. This feature ensures a secure recovery process, maintaining trust in the system while providing a safety net for users.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a3f7a3da8b54b3e2ae6f3_it198325792375.avif)

**Figure 4** The Guardians screen allows users to assign guardians for social recovery of their wallet.

‍

Lock Assets
-----------

The Wallet includes an asset locking mechanism that allows users to temporarily restrict access to their digital assets. This feature provides an additional layer of security, particularly during periods of inactivity or when enhanced protection is needed. Users can easily lock and unlock their assets through the Wallet interface, providing peace of mind that their funds are safe even if their device is lost or stolen.

‍

Manage Sessions
---------------

Session management allows users to establish secure, temporary connections to access various services within the Network. This feature enhances security by limiting the duration of access, ensuring that only authorized sessions are active. Users can view and manage their active sessions, providing greater control over their account security. This helps prevent unauthorized access and ensures that the user's financial activities remain secure.

‍

Login to Other Apps
-------------------

The Wallet can be used to sign in to other applications within the Itihad Network. This single sign-on capability streamlines access management, enabling seamless transitions between various services without the need for multiple credentials. Users can securely log in to different services with a single set of credentials, simplifying their experience and reducing the risk of password fatigue.

Technical Architecture

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

Tokenized Assets

Tokenized Assets
================

‍

The Itihad Network leverages blockchain technology to tokenize various assets, ensuring compliance with Islamic principles while providing transparency, security, and efficiency. Tokenized assets within the network include bonds (Sukuk), commodities, real estate, and intellectual property.

Tokenization involves converting physical and digital assets into tokens on the blockchain. This process provides numerous benefits, including enhanced liquidity, fractional ownership, and improved transparency. The Itihad Network uses specific ERC standards tailored for each type of asset to ensure secure and efficient management. Additionally, the network employs NFC NFTs for tagging physical products, ensuring seamless integration and tracking of assets within the network.

‍

Bonds
-----

Sukuk, or Islamic bonds, are financial certificates that comply with Sharia law. They are structured to generate returns without violating Islamic principles. The Itihad Network tokenizes Sukuk using the ERC-1400 standard, which is designed for complex securities. This standard ensures that Sukuk tokens are compliant with regulatory requirements and can be easily traded on the blockchain.

‍

Tagged Commodities
------------------

The Itihad Network tokenizes commodities such as agricultural products, physical store items, and precious metals. These tokens represent ownership of the physical commodities, ensuring that all transactions are transparent and verifiable. The ERC-1155 standard is used for these tokens, allowing for the management of multiple token types within a single contract, which is ideal for handling various commodities. Additionally, NFC NFTs are used for tagging and tracking physical commodities, providing a secure and tamper-proof method of verifying ownership and authenticity.

‍

Real Estate
-----------

Real estate tokenization involves creating digital tokens that represent ownership of physical properties. These tokens enable fractional ownership, making real estate investments more accessible. The Itihad Network uses the ERC-721 standard for real estate tokens, as it supports unique, non-fungible assets. This ensures that each property can be individually identified and traded on the blockchain.

‍

Intellectual Property
---------------------

Intellectual property (IP) assets, such as patents, trademarks, and copyrights, can be tokenized to facilitate easier transfer and licensing. The ERC-721 standard is also used for IP tokens, ensuring that each asset is unique and can be securely managed and traded. This approach enhances the liquidity of IP assets and provides a transparent record of ownership and transactions.

Credentialing

Credentialing
=============

‍

The Itihad Network enhances the verification and management of credentials through blockchain technology, ensuring authenticity and transparency. This includes Ijaza (Islamic educational certificates) and the tokenization of real-world assets.

‍

Educational Certificates
------------------------

The Network supports the issuance and verification of Ijaza, ensuring that Islamic educational credentials are authentic and recognized across the community. Educational institutions can issue Ijaza on the blockchain, providing a verifiable and immutable record of achievement. Community members and organizations can easily verify the authenticity of Ijaza, ensuring that individuals' qualifications are recognized and respected.

‍

Tokenization of Real-World Assets
---------------------------------

The Network facilitates the tokenization of real-world assets, allowing for fractional ownership and easier transfer of assets such as property, commodities, and intellectual property. Real-world assets are represented as digital tokens on the blockchain, making it easier to buy, sell, and trade fractional ownership. All transactions involving tokenized assets are recorded on the blockchain, ensuring transparency and reducing the risk of fraud.

‍

Integration with Notarization
-----------------------------

The Itihad Network's notarization system, as detailed in the [Attestations](https://coda.io/d/_duMWHCKXA5x/_surZO)
 section, further strengthens the credentialing process. By using ETH attestations and a network of notaries appointed by Qadis, the Network ensures that all credentials and tokenized assets are verified and authenticated according to the highest standards. This integration provides an additional layer of trust and security, ensuring that all transactions and credentials are legitimate and recognized across the community.

‍

Real-Life Use Cases
-------------------

*   **Educational Credentials**: Islamic scholars and students can receive Ijaza that are securely stored and verifiable on the blockchain. This ensures that their educational achievements are recognized globally and cannot be tampered with.
*   **Fractional Property Ownership**: Community members can invest in property through tokenization, allowing them to own a fraction of a property. This lowers the barrier to entry for property investment and promotes broader participation in real estate markets.
*   **Commodities Trading**: The Network enables the tokenization of commodities such as gold and silver, allowing for transparent and secure trading. This provides an ethical and Sharia-compliant way to invest in and trade commodities.
*   **Intellectual Property**: Creators can tokenize their intellectual property, such as books or research, allowing for fractional ownership and easier distribution of royalties. This ensures that creators are fairly compensated for their work.

Technical Architecture

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66572ea1e52b0a26510b004d/681f82f97cf65c69f5998498_Chevron%20right.svg)

SDK

SDK
===

‍

The Itihad Network Software Development Kit (SDK) equips developers with the necessary tools and resources to integrate with and utilize the features of the Itihad Network. The SDK provides a comprehensive suite of APIs, libraries, and documentation to support the development of secure and compliant applications.

Available for various platforms, including JavaScript, Android, and iOS, the SDK facilitates the creation of applications that interact with the network’s blockchain infrastructure, payment protocols, smart contracts, and other features. It ensures that all integrations are secure, efficient, and adhere to Islamic principles.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a4609c3ae6524b83435db_itf17.avif)

**Figure 17** The technical layers of the Itihad Network that enables 3rd-party apps.

‍

Login Button
------------

The SDK includes a "Login with Itihad" button, allowing users to authenticate themselves using their Itihad Network credentials. This feature provides a secure and convenient method for users to access various applications and services within the network, leveraging decentralized identity protocols to ensure user privacy and data security.

Developers can integrate the "Login with Itihad" button into their applications by following these steps:

*   **SDK Integration**: Include the Itihad SDK in the application’s development environment. This involves adding the necessary libraries and dependencies.
*   **API Usage**: Utilize the provided authentication API to facilitate the login process. The API handles user authentication and returns a token that grants access to the application.
*   **Button Design**: Incorporate a customizable "Login with Itihad" button in the application's UI. The SDK provides design guidelines to ensure a consistent user experience.
*   **Event Handling**: Implement event handlers to manage user login events. This includes processing the authentication token and handling successful or failed login attempts.
*   **Data Security**: Ensure that user data is securely transmitted and stored by employing encryption and following best practices for data security.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a462dad8829907f977c83_itf18.avif)

**Figure 18** An example app that allows user to “Login with Itihad”.

‍

Payments API
------------

The Payments API within the SDK allows developers to integrate secure and efficient payment processing into their applications. This API supports various payment methods, including onchain transactions and ERC-20 token transfers, ensuring compliance with Islamic financial principles. The Payments API provides features for transaction management, handling payments, refunds, and transaction status queries. It ensures secure transaction processing with encryption and multi-signature support while integrating KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) checks to ensure regulatory compliance.

‍

Security and Compliance
-----------------------

The SDK includes tools to ensure that applications built on the Itihad Network comply with Islamic standards and regulatory requirements. Developers must ensure that their applications meet content and data management guidelines, with a moderation process involving both automated AI systems and community feedback to maintain high standards of content integrity.

Advanced security protocols such as encryption, multi-signature wallets, and regular security audits are employed to protect applications and user data, ensuring compliance with international standards and Islamic principles. All applications undergo a thorough review process before being deployed on the network to ensure they adhere to the network's ethical, security, and quality standards.

Admin Dashboard

Admin Dashboard
===============

‍

The Admin Dashboard is a specialized application accessible only to the DAO of Trustees within the Itihad Network. This dashboard provides essential tools and functionalities for overseeing the health of the Network, managing critical operations, and ensuring compliance with Islamic principles. Modeled after the [Aragon DAO](https://aragon.org/)
, it is designed to provide comprehensive governance and oversight, ensuring that all decisions are made transparently and democratically.

‍

Overview
--------

The Admin Dashboard offers a comprehensive overview of the Network’s status and health. Trustees can monitor key metrics and demographic data, allowing for informed decision-making and ensuring smooth operation. The dashboard displays real-time data on the performance and stability of the Network, including transaction volumes, system uptime, and security alerts. It also provides insights into user demographics, helping trustees understand the composition and needs of the community.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a40b0a5ca3597ed836220_29e8gh9whruegedfrg.avif)

**Figure 7** The Admin Dashboard shows a high-level view of network health and stats.

‍

Voting on Proposals
-------------------

The Admin Dashboard facilitates voting on proposals and resolutions. Trustees can create, review, and vote on proposals related to Network policies, strategic initiatives, and other important matters. Key metrics and demographic data are presented to inform voting decisions, ensuring that actions align with the community's best interests. This democratic process is a core aspect of the DAO structure, promoting transparency and accountability within the Network.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a40d4d7d614e5dbb856a8_i3t2938hf0sdg.avif)

**Figure 8** The Governance page allows DAO of Trustees to vote on network proposals.

‍

Identity Verification
---------------------

The Admin Dashboard includes robust tools for decentralized identity verification and critical account management. Identity verification is conducted by a decentralized network of notaries, enhancing the security and integrity of the process. The KYC (Know Your Customer) feature ensures that all users meet the Network’s identity verification standards while maintaining data protection and privacy. This method is significantly more secure than traditional KYC companies, as the verification data is encrypted and stored on the blockchain, ensuring that it is immutable and protected from unauthorized access.

‍

Direct Intervention
-------------------

The DAO of Trustees, consisting of 12,000 members selected for their trustworthiness within the international Muslim community, has the authority to intervene in certain circumstances to maintain the integrity and security of the Network. This includes emergency actions in response to security breaches or other critical situations. Oversight and governance are conducted transparently and in alignment with Islamic principles, ensuring that all interventions are conducted ethically and responsibly.

Third Party Apps

Third Party Apps
================

‍

The Itihad Network supports integration with third-party applications, enabling a seamless and expansive ecosystem of services that adhere to Islamic principles. This integration allows users to access a variety of applications, enhancing their experience and providing a wide range of functionalities within the Network.

Third-party app integration enables developers to create and connect their applications to the Itihad Network, fostering a diverse and robust ecosystem. This ensures that users have access to a broad spectrum of services, all operating within the secure and transparent framework of the Network.

‍

App Marketplace
---------------

The Itihad Network features an App Marketplace where users can discover, download, and use third-party applications. This marketplace is curated to ensure that all apps comply with Islamic principles and meet the Network’s security and quality standards.

All third-party applications undergo a rigorous approval process to ensure they meet the Network's ethical, security, and quality standards. This process includes ensuring compliance with Islamic principles and Sharia law, conducting thorough security assessments to protect user data and maintain Network integrity, and evaluating the app's functionality and user experience to ensure it meets high standards. Integration with third-party apps enhances the functionality of the Itihad Network, providing users with additional tools and services.

‍

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681891861c959d9ef7314a0a/682a3fcd3520fbfb6fe30105_it1283749235.avif)

**Figure 5** The alternate Islamic tech ecosystem as a parallel to that of Silicon Valley.

‍

Data Access
-----------

The Network ensures that users have control over their data and how it is shared with third-party applications. Users can manage permissions, granting or revoking access to their information as needed. Data privacy is maintained by ensuring that user data is only shared with trusted applications and used responsibly. Transparency is provided through clear information on how data is accessed and used by third-party apps.

The Network will continuously monitor integrated third-party applications to ensure ongoing compliance and performance. This includes regular audits to ensure apps remain compliant with Network standards, performance tracking to monitor app performance and user feedback, and security updates to address vulnerabilities and maintain data protection.

‍

Secure API  
------------

Developers can integrate their applications with the Itihad Network through secure API access. This allows third-party apps to interact with the Network’s core functionalities, such as identity verification, payment processing, and credential management, ensuring seamless interoperability.

The Itihad Foundation will offer extensive support for developers, including documentation, SDKs, and technical assistance. This support encourages innovation and helps developers create high-quality applications that enhance the Network’s ecosystem.

Charter Cities

Charter Cities
==============

‍

The Itihad Network aims to create Charter Cities that function with a high degree of autonomy, drawing on successful precedents and best practices from around the world. These cities will operate under their own legal and regulatory frameworks, fostering economic development and ensuring alignment with Islamic principles.

The Itihad Network will incorporate the best strategies from existing successful charter cities. This includes leveraging international treaties like the New York Convention for arbitration and aligning with local and international arbitration laws to ensure legal robustness.

‍

Precedents
----------

The Reedy Creek Improvement District in Florida, established by Disney, serves as a key precedent. This district operates with significant autonomy, managing its own infrastructure, services, and regulations. Similarly, Prospera in Honduras and the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) offer models of highly autonomous zones that attract global businesses through favorable legal and economic frameworks. By adopting elements from these models, the Itihad Network can create cities that are self-sufficient and efficiently managed.

‍

Government and Taxation
-----------------------

To attract residents and businesses, the Charter Cities will prioritize having no sales or property taxes. This tax-friendly environment will make these cities appealing destinations for investment and settlement, fostering economic growth and development.

Establishing Charter Cities requires negotiating with host governments to secure the necessary legal and regulatory autonomy. The Itihad Network will work closely with these governments to create agreements that allow for the independent operation of these cities while ensuring mutual benefits.

‍

Tokenized Real Estate
---------------------

All land and real estate within the Charter Cities will be tokenized within the Network system. This ensures transparency, security, and ease of transactions, making property ownership and investment more accessible and efficient.

‍

Innovative Development
----------------------

These Charter Cities will leverage cutting-edge technologies and innovative governance models to enhance efficiency and sustainability:

*   **Smart City Technologies**: Implementing advanced technologies for efficient city management, including smart grids, IoT devices, and automated public services.
*   **Sustainable Development**: Prioritizing environmentally friendly practices and sustainable urban planning to create cities that are not only economically vibrant but also ecologically responsible.
*   **Business-Friendly Environment**: Creating an attractive environment for businesses through minimal bureaucracy and supportive policies.
*   **Education and Healthcare**: Ensuring high standards in education and healthcare services to enhance the quality of life for residents.
*   **Cultural and Social Integration**: Promoting cultural and social activities that align with Islamic values, fostering a strong sense of community.

‍

New Islamic Urbanism
--------------------

The development philosophy for these Charter Cities combines the principles of New Urbanism with traditional compact Islamic urbanism. This approach focuses on creating walkable neighborhoods, mixed-use developments, and vibrant public spaces that promote social interaction and community cohesion. By integrating modern urban planning techniques with the cultural and architectural heritage of Islamic cities, the Itihad Network aims to create urban environments that are both functional and reflective of Islamic values.

‍

Antifragility Roadmap

Antifragility Roadmap
=====================

‍

The Itihad Network's technical architecture is designed to be robust, scalable, and adaptable to future advancements. The network aims to continuously evolve, incorporating new technologies and methodologies to enhance its security, efficiency, and compliance with Islamic principles. This section outlines the roadmap for future improvements and the steps planned to ensure the network remains at the forefront of blockchain technology.

‍

Adding More Blockchains
-----------------------

To ensure the network's resilience and adaptability, the Itihad Network is focused on incorporating multiple Layer 1 (L1) blockchains. This diversification helps maximize the types of consensus mechanisms and enhances the network's antifragility.

The network plans to integrate additional L1 blockchains such as Polkadot, Avalanche, and Binance Smart Chain. This approach increases the network's resilience and allows for interoperability between different blockchain ecosystems. By leveraging a variety of consensus mechanisms, such as Proof of Stake, Delegated Proof of Stake, and Proof of Authority, the network can enhance security, scalability, and decentralization. This strategy ensures that the network can adapt to different use cases and threat models.

Furthermore, having multiple L1 blockchains ensures that the network remains operational and secure even if it is targeted or kicked off a particular blockchain due to anti-Muslim sentiment or if a blockchain experiences technical failures.

‍

Ethereum Anchoring
------------------

The Ceramic Network regularly anchors its data state onto the Ethereum blockchain. Similarly, the Itihad Network will implement data anchoring to Ethereum to ensure long-term immutability and provide a timestamped record of data integrity. This anchoring mechanism acts as a security and verification layer for data stored across various blockchains.

Even while operating on other L1 blockchains, data from the Itihad Network can be periodically anchored to Ethereum. This involves creating cryptographic hashes of the data and storing these hashes on Ethereum, ensuring that, regardless of the primary blockchain, the integrity and immutability of the data are preserved by Ethereum's robust security infrastructure.

‍

Advancing Security Measures
---------------------------

To further protect user privacy, the Itihad Network plans to integrate advanced privacy-preserving technologies such as zk-SNARKs and zk-STARKs. These technologies enable the verification of transactions and data without revealing sensitive information, ensuring that user privacy is maintained at all times.

The network will also implement advanced security measures to protect against emerging threats and ensure the integrity of the system. These measures include conducting regular security audits to identify and address vulnerabilities, expanding the use of multi-signature wallets for critical transactions to enhance security, and implementing advanced threat detection systems to monitor and mitigate potential security breaches.

‍

Integration with Emerging Technologies
--------------------------------------

The Itihad Network will explore the integration of emerging technologies such as AI, IoT, and edge computing to enhance the network's capabilities and provide new use cases. Leveraging AI for predictive analytics, user behavior analysis, and automated decision-making will enhance the network's functionality.

For example, AI can be used to detect and prevent fraudulent activities by analyzing transaction patterns and identifying anomalies in real-time. Integrating IoT devices and edge computing solutions will facilitate real-time data processing and decentralized applications, such as using NFC tags and IoT sensors for tracking and verifying tokenized assets. These technologies will enable the network to offer more sophisticated and efficient services, ensuring it remains at the cutting edge of technological advancements.
